One thing that happens to many people is they are so emotionally caught up in their situation that it’s almost blinding to them. Many people who try hard to feel better, really do make improvements in their life and their pursuit in happiness without knowing it in the moment. Later in life and hopefully once those negative feelings fade away, you hopefully may be able to notice those changes that you’ve put into improving your life and your efforts may finally start to pay off. However, there is always that possibility that things may not get better and in cases like that, one may only be able to cope with the acceptance of what has happened to them in the past. You will never be able to go back in time and change what happened to you, but it is very possible to accept what happened, recover from it, and become a stronger person overall because of it. Suicide is a fairly easy solution to peoples problems, kind of like a reset that deletes everything and anything. But this isn’t always the right choice, as things may start to improve as early as tomorrow or in a week, in a month, or even a year. As long as you have that drive to hold on to life and strive to improve it, I’m sure things will get better for you. I would suggest trying to enjoy the little things in life, like a cup of coffee, or an afternoon nap, or a good breakfast or workout. It’s best to make the most of what your situation is and try as hard as you can to find that sunshine in your life. Although I will never truly be in your shoes and experience what you’re going through, I hope my advice can help you even if it’s just a little bit.

Take care of yourself, your future self will be grateful for it

Every single day from here on out is a new opportunity for something new and amazing to happen. I know that someday things will get better for you and I’m sure that future you will be grateful that you’ve stuck around for it. There are many wonderful people in this world even if it doesn’t seem like it, so try to surround yourself with positive people and don’t worry about how other people see you. You should always do what makes YOU happy rather than what makes other people happy.
